notes.title: Early Access Version 0.2.11-46
notes.notes:
[h2]Happy Lunar New Year, Pioneers! [/h2]

We hope you're enjoying your adventures in Native Isekai Defense! To kick off the new year, we’re bringing you an update with important fixes and improvements.

[h3]This update brings:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Fixed a critical bug where attacks couldn't damage enemies[/b]—now you can take down foes as intended! 
[*] [b]Added a Cutscene & Dialogue Skip Button[/b]—breeze through the story at your own pace! 
[*] [b]Enhanced VFX for Hestia and Axel[/b]—new visuals to make battles more dynamic! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174889/3d9f3c466bd4be39458af2ac046f479d4467dcc0.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Various minor bug fixes for a smoother gameplay experience.[/b] [/list]

Thank you for your support and feedback, and may this Lunar New Year bring you great fortune and epic victories!

notes.title: Early Access Version 0.2.11-38 Notes
notes.notes:
Hello Pioneers!

A new update has finally arrived.
In this update, we've added some new features and made a few changes to existing ones.
Let's dive right into the new features included in this update:

[h3]1. City Environment.[/h3]
    
    The Town Hub is finally here. This city will serve as the base of operations for the Pioneer Squad. Now, the Lobby will be located within the city. So, you can now leave the lobby and explore a new environment.
    [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174889/8cfa86b21b84bc1426fec6e1336f15cb157b138b.gif[/img]

[h3]2. New Intro and Tutorial.[/h3]
  
    As the city environment expands, we have also started to develop the lore of this game's world. Therefore, we have created an introductory cutscene at the beginning of the game. This intro will delve deeper into our main character, Hestia Vermeil.
    Not only is there a new intro, but we have also updated the tutorial to better connect with the story introduced in the initial intro.
    
[h3]3. Stamina System[/h3]
    
    We have introduced a new system, stamina. Now, characters will use stamina to run and dodge.  
    Note: The Stamina System does not apply in the City environment.
    

In addition to the new features above, we have also added or updated existing features:

[h3]1. Jump Pad[/h3]
    
    A new building has arrived, the Jump Pad! With this, you can leap directly into the midst of enemies, or reach places that are not accessible by ordinary jumping.
  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174889/2f0ea3e3bf6cea7d7012088ce990a34ddf8187ec.gif[/img]
    
[h3]2. Bot Behaviour[/h3]
    
    We have improved bot behavior so that they can revive players more effectively.
    
[h3]3. Shadow Quality[/h3]
    
    We have updated the quality of shadows in the game so that they render even better.

We're excited for you to experience these enhancements and hope they enrich your gameplay. As always, we appreciate your feedback and support, which are crucial in shaping future updates. Enjoy exploring the new features and improvements!

Happy gaming, Pioneers!

notes.title: Early Access Version 0.2.10-38 Notes
notes.notes:
Hello Pioneers!

The new update is finally here!
In this update, we’ve tweaked some existing features and introduced a few new ones.

[h3]Building System[/h3]
[list]
[*]Buildings are now unlockable! Unlike before, where all buildings were available from the start, players now need to complete stages to unlock new buildings.
[*]Only Barricades and Foundations are available at the start of the game.
[*]Added a new building: Artillery.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174889/0b009c07566cb2d80345b90ac1af60a336be0768.gif[/img]

[h3]Points of Interest (POIs)[/h3]
We’ve added POIs to the stages!
Each POI will feature large crystals to mine or treasure chests that reward players with new catalysts. Explore the stage to find these unique spots, but stay alert—powerful monsters guard every POI!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174889/84480d20214438f6ca4b54a90b413f56dc1ef340.gif[/img]

[h3]Crystals[/h3]
Crystals now come in multiple sizes: small, medium, large, and super!
Also, crystals can no longer be mined if monsters are nearby. You’ll need to defeat the monsters first before mining.

[h3]Enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added elite monsters to every stage.
[*]Introduced roaming monsters that wander around the map.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174889/2cb883a9f743fd5b91a76675b9a8058f099f7700.gif[/img]

[h3]Stage Clear Progress Reset[/h3]
We’ve made some changes to stage selection. Now, all stages except Dragon Valley will be locked. Players must clear each stage in sequence to unlock new ones.
As a result, all player stage progress has been reset.

[h3]Level and Experience System[/h3]
We’ve introduced a new level and experience system!
Players now gain experience by defeating enemies. When the experience bar is full, the player levels up.
Leveling up allows you to choose a new catalyst. This replaces the old system where catalysts were gained automatically at the end of each wave.
Now, it’s all about defeating enemies and becoming the strongest!
Additionally, experience points are shared among all team or squad members, so everyone benefits equally.

Enjoy the update and have fun exploring the new features!

notes.title: Devlog #1: Crystal and Point of Interest
notes.notes:
Hello, Pioneers!

Welcome to the very first devlog for Native Isekai Defense! In this devlog, we’ll be sharing progress on what we’ve been working on and some plans we might implement in the future.

Alright, let’s dive straight into the progress update!

[h2]Progress Update[/h2]

[h3]Crystals[/h3]
We’ve made some adjustments to crystals to make the game even more exciting. Here’s what’s new:

Crystals can’t be mined if there are monsters nearby. You’ll need to defeat the monsters first before you can start mining.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174889/b2e09bb0e71302b9d53e34117d5717bf0b6540ba.gif[/img]

Crystals now come in different sizes: small, medium, and large! Larger crystals are more likely to spawn at Points of Interest (POIs) scattered across the stage. Speaking of POIs, let’s move on to the next point.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174889/63f3ba3bbec548b44623e1c5dce8696553f8c64c.gif[/img]

[h3]Points of Interest (POIs)[/h3]
In the current version, players can build towers and barricades using crystals found across the map. But let’s be honest—just running around mining crystals gets a bit boring, right?

To make stage exploration more exciting, we’re adding POIs throughout the map. At these POIs, you’ll find:
- Crystals: The chances of finding large crystals here are higher compared to regular areas.
- Treasure: Opening treasure chests will reward you with new catalysts.
- Monsters: Every POI will be guarded by monsters, ranging from regular enemies to elite ones.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174889/d8cb498f5fa82884110ebace25537cd9af53067e.gif[/img]

[h3]Monster Updates[/h3]
We’re planning to add more monsters across the stage. As usual, waves of monsters will attack the Ethereal Nexus, but now there will also be wandering monsters roaming the map.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174889/1db997fd17b2562b060d7919e77bc38a7767eb1d.gif[/img]

We’re also introducing elite monsters! These are stronger variants of existing monsters with significantly higher stats, offering a fresh challenge for players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174889/c4c0502ea09de0fda93ec6dca05582ad5700c44c.gif[/img]

Elite monsters will come in different types, such as:
- Elite Defender: Monsters with boosted defense stats.
- Elite Attacker: Monsters with boosted attack stats.

For wandering monsters, their levels will depend on how far they are from the Ethereal Nexus. The farther away they are, the higher their level. Closer monsters will have lower levels.

[h3]New Buildings[/h3]
We’re planning to add two new buildings:

Artillery Tower: A tower that can attack enemies from a long distance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174889/e811c49f5a95b059591c648deb9b0342dcbeb426.png[/img]
Jump Pad: This lets you jump quickly to distant areas. With Jump Pads, you can travel between POIs or return to the base/Ethereal Nexus in no time after mining far away.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174889/226ea8ddfd3bc533a7b8139e35ee4f942d43d654.png[/img]

[h3]Town Hub[/h3]
The Town Hub is currently in development! So far, we’ve added the Lobby, Town Square, residential areas, gardens, and a Blacksmith.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174889/fd11f9ab313eb9f83e03704b5e815b2f9a71240f.gif[/img]

We’re working hard to ensure some of these new features and systems make it into the next update, which we’re aiming to release during this week’s Winter Sale.
Just a quick note: the footage shown above is not final and is subject to change before the update goes live.
And that’s all for this devlog! Stay tuned for more progress in future devlogs.

Good morning, good evening, and good night, Pioneers!

notes.title: Early Access Version 0.2.9-4 Notes

we also implemented some of your suggestions.

- Added "Crystal" - You need Crystals to build buildings. Crystals can be found in the stages that will spawn every time the preparation phase starts.
- There are now barricade, foundation, cannon, Ballista and wire fence that you can build.
- Reduce revive duration.
- Added victory animations for Heilig Sagrate and Nir Juede.
- Fix indicator that doesn't show up in grass.
- And some minor improvements.

Enjoy the new feature. If you have any suggestion, don't hesitate to tell us. Thanks a lot for your support!
